desktopReleases.admin.config.description: Store the desktop release pipeline settings in the UI so admins can update them without editing environment variables.
desktopReleases.admin.config.title: Desktop release configuration
desktopReleases.admin.config.githubToken: Used only to trigger the workflow. The value is stored encrypted. Leave blank to keep the current token.
Leave blank to keep the current token
Paste a GitHub personal access token
Create the token directly in GitHub before pasting it here. Use a fine-grained personal access token with Actions write access on the repository you selected above.
Open your GitHub profile menu and go to Settings.
Select Developer settings, then Personal access tokens, then Fine-grained tokens.
Generate a token for the repository that hosts this app and grant Actions: write. You can also add read access to Contents if your GitHub policy requires it.
Copy the token once, paste it into the form above, and save the configuration. The value is stored encrypted.
desktopReleases.admin.config.guide.descr: Follow these steps once. After that, builds and uploads can run entirely from the UI.
desktopReleases.admin.config.guide.step1: Open the SmartAIHub public web domain that users will download releases from, for example https://smartaihub.app.
desktopReleases.admin.config.guide.step2: Enter the GitHub repository, workflow file, and ref that should receive the build dispatch. Most deployments use the main branch and desktop-release.yml.
desktopReleases.admin.config.guide.step3: Paste a GitHub token with workflow-dispatch permissions. This token is encrypted in the UI and is only used to queue build jobs.
desktopReleases.admin.config.guide.step4: Save the form. If any row still shows Legacy fallback, save it here to move the system fully into UI-managed settings.
desktopReleases.admin.config.guide.step5: Use the build card below to choose a version, add release notes, and select Windows, macOS, or all supported platforms before queuing the build.
desktopReleases.admin.config.guide.step6: When the workflow finishes, it uploads the installer to the SmartAIHub portal automatically. Users then download it from the Dashboard page or the desktop releases section.
desktopReleases.admin.config.missingRequ: Please fill in the repository, workflow, ref, and public URL before saving.
desktopReleases.admin.config.note: The workflow upload token is generated automatically when you queue a build, so you do not need to paste a second token here. GitHub token changes are stored encrypted.
desktopReleases.admin.config.repositoryH: Use the repo that contains this application, for example naibarn/SmartAIHub or your SmartAIHub production fork.
desktopReleases.admin.config.reminderBod: If a row still shows Legacy fallback, that value is still coming from environment variables. Save it here to move the setting fully into the UI.
